description:
The Ministry of Local Government has split the 'Tikonko' chiefdom in Bo District. You need to update the DHIS2 hierarchy to reflect this change.

1. Login to DHIS2 (admin/district).
2. Open the Maintenance app (Organisation Unit section).
3. Create a new Organisation Unit named 'Tikonko North' (Short name: 'Tikonko N') as a child of 'Bo' District. Set the opening date to 2023-01-01.
4. Move the existing facility 'Tikonko CHC' from its current location into the new 'Tikonko North' chiefdom.
5. Move the existing facility 'Gondama MCHP' from its current location into the new 'Tikonko North' chiefdom.

Verify that both facilities are now children of Tikonko North in the hierarchy.
